membraneSystems.description: Specialized 2-compartment EDBM architecture engineered for continuous direct acidification and decationization of food liquids. transportMechanisms.phenomenon: Catalytic Water Dissociation in Bipolar Membrane Interfacial Junction
transportMechanisms.equation: H2O + (ZrO2/Fe-OH catalyst) -> H+ + OH-  [Delta V_cat ≈ 0.83 V + eta_cat + I * R_BPM]
transportMechanisms.description: Under reverse electrical bias, water molecules entering the hydrophilic nanostructured catalytic junction between cation and anion layers undergo rapid dissociation, generating protons towards the anode (acid chamber) and hydroxide ions towards the cathode (base chamber) with minimal overpotential (<0.2 V).

transportMechanisms.phenomenon: Electrochemical Trans-Membrane Ionic Migration & Current Efficiency
transportMechanisms.equation: eta_current = (z * F * (C_acid,final * V_acid - C_acid,init * V_acid)) / (N_cells * I * Delta_t)
transportMechanisms.description: Quantifies the fraction of total electrical current dedicated to transporting organic carboxylate anions and generating protons, accounting for parasitic back-diffusion of H+ and OH- across monopolar membranes and co-ion leakage.

transportMechanisms.phenomenon: Limiting Current Density & Boundary Layer Concentration Polarization
transportMechanisms.description: Defines the maximum permissible current density before feed solution ions at the membrane boundary layer become entirely depleted, triggering undesirable water dissociation at monopolar membranes, Joule heating, and membrane surface charring.

transportMechanisms.phenomenon: Specific Electrical Energy Consumption (SEC) per Kilogram of Recovered Acid
transportMechanisms.description: Calculates the total kilowatt-hours of electrical energy consumed per kilogram of pure undissociated organic acid produced, integrating stack ohmic resistance, water-splitting potential, and fluid pumping power.

Measures the mass of hazardous solid calcium sulfate dihydrate (gypsum) sludge completely eliminated from the environment compared to conventional sulfuric acid acidification processes (1.0 to 1.9 kg gypsum avoided per kg acid).

safetyAndSanitationStandards.requirement: All product contact frames, spacers, and distribution manifolds must be fabricated from food-grade FDA compliant polymers (PVDF, PTFE, virgin PP) and 316L electropolished stainless steel with self-draining flow geometry.
safetyAndSanitationStandards.compliance: Stack endplates machined from 316L SS, FDA-grade PVDF screen spacers with low-dead-volume fluid seals, and sanitary tri-clamp fluid manifolds.

safetyAndSanitationStandards.standard: EHEDG Class I EL Aseptic Design Criteria for Electro-Membrane Devices
safetyAndSanitationStandards.requirement: Zero-stagnation fluid distributor channels, hermetic elastomer perimeter seals, in-line Clean-In-Place (CIP) cleanability with validated 5-log microbial eradication without disassembly.
safetyAndSanitationStandards.compliance: Validated automated CIP sequence featuring reverse electrical polarity pulses, food-grade acid/alkali sanitation flushes, and automated conductometric cleanliness verification.

safetyAndSanitationStandards.standard: FDA 21 CFR § 178.3297 / 21 CFR § 184 (Direct Food Substance GRAS Specifications)
safetyAndSanitationStandards.requirement: Ion-exchange resins, polymer binders, and catalytic junction materials must exhibit zero toxic heavy metal or plasticizer migration into food acid streams under continuous electrical bias.
safetyAndSanitationStandards.compliance: Certified USP Class VI and FDA 21 CFR § 177 polymers with validated heavy metal migration limits (<0.01 mg/kg for Zr, Fe, Cr, and Ni).

safetyAndSanitationStandards.standard: OSHA 29 CFR § 1910.303 & NFPA 497 (Electrolytic Gas Dissipation & Electrical Safety)
safetyAndSanitationStandards.requirement: Electrolytic hydrogen gas (H2) produced at the cathode and oxygen (O2) at the anode must be continuously diluted below 25% of the Lower Explosive Limit (LEL < 1% H2 by volume) with automated air scavenging.
safetyAndSanitationStandards.compliance: Redundant forced-air degasser blowers, explosion-proof catalytic recombiners, and automated interlocks that de-energize the DC rectifier within 50 ms if airflow drops below threshold.
